name: UvPython
description: Install Python versions with uv, from an explicit list or from .python-version
helpMarkDown: Install Python versions with uv and optionally make one the default
author: Henry Daniel Mosquera

inputs.name: versions
inputs.label: Python versions
inputs.helpMarkDown: One per line or comma separated. Any uv request: `3.13`, `3.12.4`, `pypy@3.10`, `>=3.11`. Takes priority over the version file. Leave empty to read the version file.

inputs.name: pythonVersionFile
inputs.label: Version file
inputs.helpMarkDown: Used only when 'Python versions' is empty. Relative to the working directory. Supports `.python-version` (one request per line, `#` comments) and `.tool-versions` (`python 3.12.4`).

inputs.name: setDefault
inputs.label: Use the first version as default
inputs.helpMarkDown: Makes the first version the default for the following steps: sets UV_PYTHON to its path and, for interpreters managed by uv, puts it first in the PATH so `python` and `python3` resolve to it.

inputs.name: writePythonVersionFile
inputs.label: Write .python-version
inputs.helpMarkDown: After installing, runs `uv python pin` with the first version so the working directory keeps it. Ignored when the versions come from the file.

inputs.name: pythonPreference
inputs.label: Python preference
inputs.helpMarkDown: Maps to UV_PYTHON_PREFERENCE and is inherited by the following steps. With `only-system` nothing is downloaded; uv only looks for interpreters already on the agent.

inputs.name: pythonInstallMirror
inputs.label: Python install mirror
inputs.helpMarkDown: Maps to UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_MIRROR (python-build-standalone mirror) for agents without internet access.

inputs.name: autoInstallUv
inputs.label: Install uv if missing
inputs.helpMarkDown: If uv is not found, download it (same logic as the UvSetup task). Disable on locked-down agents and run UvSetup / pre-bake uv instead.

inputs.name: uvVersion
inputs.label: uv version
inputs.helpMarkDown: Only used when uv has to be installed. `latest` or an exact version such as `0.8.0`.

outputVariables.name: pythonVersion
outputVariables.description: Full version of the default interpreter

outputVariables.name: pythonInstalledVersions
outputVariables.description: JSON list of {request, path, version, managed} for every requested version
